llm.summary: The skill's code, instructions, and resource needs are coherent with an Excel/VBA helper: it produces and explains VBA text and stores small local logs; it does not request credentials or reach out to external endpoints.

dimensions.detail: Name/description (VBA/macro helper) match the included files and runtime instructions. The scripts generate/explain/debug/return VBA snippets and templates; nothing requires unrelated privileges or cloud credentials.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: SKILL.md explicitly tells the agent to run the included bash script (scripts/macro.sh). The scripts only produce text (VBA code, tips) and do not read system secrets. Note: generated VBA examples may contain actions that, if later executed inside Excel by the user, can access files, open workbooks, or send email via Outlook — the skill outputs code but does not itself execute those macros.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec (instruction-only plus included shell scripts). No downloads or external installers are present, so nothing arbitrary is written to disk beyond the scripts that are already bundled.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill does not require credentials or special env vars. scripts/script.sh will create a data directory under ${MACRO_HELPER_DIR:-${XDG_DATA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/share}/macro-helper} and write data.log/history.log; MACRO_HELPER_DIR can be set by the user. This is proportionate but means user-provided task text may be logged locally.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: always is false and the skill does not request elevated privileges. It persists small local files in the user's data folder (config/data/history logs) — standard for a CLI helper and limited in scope.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill appears to do what it says: generate and explain VBA/macros. Before installing or running, review the bundled scripts (they are small and local) and be aware they will create a data directory (by default ~/.local/share/macro-helper) and append logs/history there. The skill only outputs VBA text; it does not call external servers or require credentials. However, any VBA code you copy into Excel can perform powerful actions (file I/O, open/close workbooks, send email via Outlook, run commands). Always inspect generated macros before enabling or running them, avoid enabling macros from untrusted sources, and consider setting MACRO_HELPER_DIR to a controlled location or running the tool in an isolated environment if you will pass sensitive descriptions to it.
